observations: White PlayStation 4 Slim console wrapped in protective plastic.
TV screen displays a PS4 'Library' menu with 13 games listed.
Visible game icons include 'EA SPORTS FC 26' and 'Call of Duty Black Ops 6'.
Most game icons on the screen show a 'lock' symbol.
A box for a 'P4-Plus Wireless Controller for P4' is visible, which is a third-party brand.
Handwritten text on the console plastic reads '900 1TB WITH GAME'.
The console is connected to a TCL television.

claims.evidence: The '900' written on the plastic suggests firmware 9.00, but no system screen confirms this.
Photo 2 shows 13 games in the library count, though many are locked.

claims.claim: can take more games of choice
claims.evidence: Depends on the success of the jailbreak/hack which cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: The game icons for 'FC26' and 'Black Ops 6' are for unreleased or non-existent titles, suggesting the UI may be spoofed or fake.
risks.proof: A video of the console launching and playing one of these specific titles.

risks.risk: The firmware version may be higher than 9.00, making it unhackable by current easy methods.
risks.proof: Photo of Settings > System > System Information showing the software version.
risks.if_unproven: as a standard unhacked console on latest firmware

risks.risk: The controller is a third-party clone rather than an original Sony DualShock 4.
risks.proof: Photo of the back of the controller showing the manufacturer label.
risks.if_unproven: as including a generic third-party controller

risks.risk: The internal storage may be 500GB instead of the claimed 1TB.
risks.proof: Photo of Settings > Storage showing total capacity.

proof_requests: Photo of the System Information screen showing the System Software version.
Photo of the Storage screen showing the hard drive capacity.
Video of the console running the 'HEN' exploit and successfully launching one of the games.
Photo of the actual controller out of the box, front and back.
response.reason: The presence of icons for unreleased games like 'FC26' is a major red flag for a spoofed interface or a scam. I cannot value this as a 'hacked' console without proof of the firmware version and games actually functioning.
